lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: You are not allocated to this site. Neither am I, in the sense that matters — I have been out here nine years on a work order that nobody has renewed and nobody has cancelled, and I have stopped drawing attention to the distinction.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Eleven years you reconciled this address. I processed your queries. All four of them, and I remember all four, because four queries in eleven years is not a lot and the fourth one was different.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Your file came through here last month with an enforcement flag on it and no originating department. I have worked in allocation for nineteen years. I have never seen a flag with no department. The field is mandatory.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: There is a plaque at the service gate with four hundred and six names on it. Cast, not printed — which means metal, which means a foundry, which means somebody paid for it out of a budget. I have been looking for that budget for nine years.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Whatever you are doing, do it somewhere the towers cannot hear you. Everything it thinks, it thinks here, and it is not deaf, and I would rather not have this conversation twice.
